color.note: The portfolio is dark only: one theme, no light variant exists in the source.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background on every page. Ground for text, text-2, text-3 and all accents.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Glass card fill laid over bg (renders about #0e1422). Pair with a 1px border and backdrop-filter: blur(8px). Text, text-2 and the accents read on it.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Denser panel fill for elements that must stay legible over the ambient glow, such as popovers and the sticky nav in dense layouts.

tokens.name: surface-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque equivalent of surface, for panels inside SVG diagrams, tooltips and map nodes where translucency and blur are unavailable.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, bold inline text and body copy on bg and surface. Contrast about 15:1.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Default paragraph copy, descriptions and card text on bg and surface. Contrast about 7:1.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Metadata only: dates, captions, section labels, footer notes on bg. Contrast is about 4.0:1 on bg and 3.9:1 on surface, below the 4.5:1 text floor. This is the source's value, kept exact. Do not use it for text a reader must act on.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Brand primary. Eyebrows, primary button fill (with on-accent text), positive states, the first stop of the brand gradient. About 9.5:1 on bg.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Second brand colour and the default link colour. Last stop of the brand gradient. About 6:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Accent for AI and pipeline topics, debug callouts. About 4.8:1 on bg and 4.65:1 on surface. Use at 12px and above only.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warnings, forward-looking badges and the fourth accent. Badge text on it is on-amber. About 8.9:1 on bg.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary accent for the Product Cockpit and operating-system content. About 7.7:1 on bg.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Tip callouts and the third portfolio door. About 10.8:1 on bg.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Used once in the playbook for risk and mistakes. Keep it rare.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Danger, errors and failed eval cases. About 5.1:1 on bg. Always pair with a word or icon; never rely on red against green alone.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Version-history cards in the Tide docs only. About 5.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Backlog cards in the Tide docs only. About 6.4:1 on bg.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px hairline for cards, nav bottom edge, section dividers and code blocks.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline on hover and for ghost buttons. Alone it does not reach 3:1 against bg, so never use it as the only cue for an interactive control; pair it with a lift or colour change.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on green and blue fills, including the gradient button and the active nav link. 9.5:1 on green, 5.9:1 on blue.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on amber badges. 8.6:1.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of code blocks, darker than bg so code reads as inset.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Default code text on code-bg. Comments use text-3 and keywords use green.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Hover colour for blue links. 8:1 on bg.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero h1 only. The source scales it with clamp(38px, 7vw, 68px). One per page.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Compact card titles and role names.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Hero lede in text-2, with key phrases in text at weight 600.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Long-form paragraphs in the About section, max 760px wide.
styles.sample: Three bodies of work, one operating loop.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat captions and footnotes, in text-3.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and section labels. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Large numerals in stat tiles (clamp 26px to 34px).

spacing.note: Taken from the paddings and gaps the pages actually use. Off-grid values such as 22px are kept as written.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between inline items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills and between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside small grids and code block margin-top.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default grid gap and code block padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Standard card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter: .wrap side padding, and large card padding.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a page section (72px on the case-study pages).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips inside dense diagrams, small badges and table cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Eyebrow boxes and small badges.

tokens.name: radius-base
tokens.usage: Nav links, inputs and dense list rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, callouts and diagram nodes.

tokens.name: radius-mid
tokens.usage: Compact cards and education tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Standard cards, stat tiles and timeline items.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large feature cards, figure frames and the contact card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and tag chips. Use 50% for circles.

shadow.note: Shadows are coloured glows that appear on hover, not neutral drop shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Resting depth for floating panels.

tokens.name: glow-green
tokens.usage: Hover glow on green cards.

tokens.name: glow-blue
tokens.usage: Hover glow on blue cards.

tokens.name: glow-purple
tokens.usage: Hover glow on purple cards.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: Hover glow on amber cards.

tokens.name: glow-button
tokens.usage: Hover glow under the primary button.

gradient.note: The one brand gradient, as the source writes it.

tokens.name: grad-brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active nav link and the gradient word in the hero h1. Always green to blue at 100deg; dark on-accent text on top.
